name: ordinary-day
about: Two campaigns with leads, a month's spend and two mature cohorts beside a young one.

output.headline: November 3, 2026: 2 campaigns ran, delivering 7 leads on $284.25 spend at $40.61 cost per lead across 14,600 impressions.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet led the day with 6 leads, $184.50 spend, $30.75 cost per lead, 9,120 impressions, 141 clicks, and a 1.5% click rate.
Dedicated night runs produced 1 lead at $99.75 spend and $99.75 cost per lead from 5,480 impressions, 62 clicks, and a 1.1% click rate — cost per lead ran notably higher than the day total.
November 2026 has 28 days left; Meta spend so far this month is $612.30.
The 2026-09-21 cohort (38 leads, mature): 33 contacted, 17 converted to applicants, 10 applied, 4 hired, 8 lost after conversion.
The 2026-09-28 cohort (40 leads, mature): 36 contacted, 20 converted to applicants, 12 applied, 5 hired, 9 lost after conversion.
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads — 9 contacted, 3 converted to applicants, 1 applied, and 1 lost after conversion — but it is too young to judge its rates yet.
